scientific_integrity: The theorem and global quadratic rigidity are proved analytically; finite numerical tests are corroboration only. Primary literature compared by mathematical implication. Unindexed equivalents remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Real distributional BV on (0,1), constant convex mixture weights, unnormalized L1 error; endpoint weights have no claimed complete equality classification. No extension to variable weights, signed mixtures, non-Lebesgue measure, other dimensions or error norms. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Entropy-optimal balancing of forward and reflected Hardy averages on real bounded variation
